description.value: Georgia General is an eclectic neighbourhood general store in East Vancouver, occupying a characterful heritage building on Victoria Drive. It blends everyday grocery staples with antiques, vintage clothing, plants, records, artwork, and gifts — all sourced personally by the owner. A handy stop for a touring cyclist cutting through East Van who needs to grab provisions alongside something unexpected.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, open business at 706 Victoria Dr, Vancouver, BC V5L 4E6, matching the OSM address, phone (778 775 9422), and URL. The site lists 'Grocery' as one of its shop categories and the welcome text explicitly mentions 'grocery staples,' confirming basic groceries are stocked. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or most other cycling amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website welcome text uses the name 'Georgie General' (informal/nickname) while all page titles, footer, and OSM use 'Georgia General' — minor inconsistency, likely intentional wordplay rather than a name error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible general store with confirmed grocery stock — a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists in East Vancouver.

wow_evidence: eclectic neighbourhood general store in East Vancouver
